mapper.sql: o.id, o.course_id courseId, c.course_code courseCode, c.name courseName, c.course_type courseType, c.credit, c.weekly_periods weeklyPeriods, o.teacher_id teacherId, t.teacher_no teacherNo, t.name teacherName, o.class_id classId, ac.class_name className, o.semester_id semesterId, sem.name semesterName, o.capacity, (select count(*) from student_course total where total.offering_id = o.id) studentCount
from course_offering o join course c on c.id = o.course_id join teacher t on t.id = o.teacher_id join administrative_class ac on ac.id = o.class_id join semester sem on sem.id = o.semester_id
mapper.insert: insert into student_course(student_id, offering_id, create_time, update_time) values(#{studentId}, #{offeringId}, now(), now())
